digest.component_or_area: external integration testing / live Jira Cloud reconciler
propositions: A new read-only, S3-backed live test suite for Jira Cloud multi-project reconciliation (REB + DIG) is needed to cover S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume after DC harness landed.

The suite must exercise only read paths (compute_snapshot for inbound fetch, bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode) and structurally prevent all Jira mutations via monkeypatching AcliClient mutating methods to raise.
The test suite uses a fresh, isolated S3 store with a throwaway prefix as the sole remote, deleted on teardown, ensuring no production store contamination.
Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after each Jira-touching scenario, and unknown mapped project keys must fail closed (raise) rather than silently succeed.

The suite is gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL environment variable and AWS/Jira credentials, integrated as a dedicated jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal CI job, and excluded from the general external job to prevent double-collection.
